title: Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17407v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating realistic time-series requires faithfully reproducing rare but high-impact extreme events. Existing approaches often rely on specialized representations or extreme-focused training objectives, which may restrict the diversity of captured extremes or compromise overall distributional fidelity. We propose Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion (CrossTF), a framework that exploits discrepancies between time- and frequency-view denoisers for extreme-aware time-series generation. Our key empirical finding is extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry: moving along the direction connecting the two views' clean-sample estimates substantially changes extreme fidelity while having limited effects on overall generation quality. We further identify a late-stage cross-view window in which this discrepancy stabilizes and cross-view adjustments have a particularly strong effect on extreme fidelity. translated_title: 面向极端事件感知时间序列生成的跨视角时频扩散模型
translated_abstract: 生成真实的时间序列需要忠实地再现罕见但影响巨大的极端事件。现有方法通常依赖于专门的表示形式或以极端事件为焦点的训练目标，这可能限制所捕获极端事件的多样性，或损害整体分布的保真度。我们提出了跨视角时频扩散，这是一个利用时间视角与频率视角去噪器之间差异来实现极端事件感知时间序列生成的框架。我们的关键实证发现是“极端敏感的跨视角不对称性”：沿着连接两个视角干净样本估计的方向移动，会显著改变极端事件的保真度，而对整体生成质量的影响却很有限。我们进一步确定了一个后期跨视角窗口，在该窗口中这种差异趋于稳定，且跨视角调整对极端保真度的影响尤为强烈。这些发现启发了一种分阶段优化策略（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出CrossTF框架，利用时间视角与频率视角去噪器之间的极端敏感不对称性，在扩散生成后期窗口进行跨视角调整，从而在不损害整体生成质量的前提下大幅提升时间序列中极端事件的保真度。
en_tdlr: CrossTF exploits the extreme-sensitive asymmetry between time-view and frequency-view denoisers, applying cross-view adjustments in a late-stage diffusion window to substantially improve extreme-event fidelity in time-series generation while preserving overall distributional quality.
